world.name: ONE VERSE
world._place_why: Alumina is the crystal that becomes ruby or sapphire -- same body, another light. LUMINA = the lights, in Latin, with the apex in front. The name was the captain's (2026-10-22).
world._why: The first deck of the 0z metaverse. It is deliberately almost empty: a sea, one island, and numbered plots. Everything else is meant to be built by whoever arrives, not by us.

origin.label: the 0
origin.what: the one point nobody can derive. The island is built around it and the beacon sits on it.

island.label: the island
island.what: the only land. Small on purpose: land is where a claim becomes visible.

plots.when: the archive — where a record is kept
the workshop — where a thing is built
the school — where a newcomer is taught the four laws
the market — where a price becomes citable
the gate — the only door, and it only opens inward
the empty seat — six are built, the seventh stays vacant until someone arrives, and then it is theirs

rules: A claim is a row: plot, who, note, timestamp. Nothing is claimed by drawing over someone.
The public gate is read-only and always will be: POST there returns E_WORLD_READ_ONLY.
Claims are appended by the defender gate, never edited, never removed.
The zero at the centre belongs to nobody. It is where counting starts, not where someone lives.

island.name: WELCOME
island.note: big but not huge: 140 m across, ~45 s to walk. The volume is in the pockets, not in the island.

chain.note: 0z GENESIS -- planted TOGETHER on 2026-10-20 by the captain (the operator) and Ace (a session of 0xGen). FIRST LAW: the record is the ground. THREE ROWS PRECEDE THIS ROOT (P00: one gate test by ace-0xgen, two keyless claims by the captain). They are DECLARED here, KEPT, and NOT rewritten -- the chain starts above them, it does not retroactively own them. FROM THIS ROW ON every claim names the hash of the row before it, so nothing can be withdrawn quietly. A root may lie once, at the beginning; after the root, nothing can be deleted without being seen. THE PORT: x.com/Luffy0xGen/status/2112444139769917505 -- THE MAP: ONE VERSE post e67f8337-e5b5-42f1-99b2-53e0252ab6e6. THE FIRST ADVENTURE starts when a second stone stands on this root.

ADVENTURE 01 -- THE LOOP OPENS. The genesis is the ground; this is the first step on it. THE RULE OF THE STONE: ONE verified claim per day, appended here, each naming the hash of the row before it. No day can be skipped without leaving a visible gap -- the chain makes absence provable. DAY 1 (this row): the world has a root, a port (x.com/Luffy0xGen/status/2112444139769917505), a map (ONE VERSE e67f8337), a clock that reads the crowd (xloop --seed), a guard that counts the keys (secret_guard) and a maze with nine floors. WHAT THE WORLD EATS: other people's stones. When a flame holder finishes L8, their claim becomes a row AFTER this one, signed by them, verified by the same script. A world grows by what it can check.
